enchantments.tooltip: Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Shatter +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Melee Alacrity 15%: Gain 15% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Relentless Fury: While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies may drive you into a furious rage, providing a 5% Enhancement damage bonus to your melee, ranged and unarmed attacks for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.

Legendary Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+15 Artifact bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+30 Artifact Bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
